# MASE IDE adapter

Before changing or reviewing this project, read `project-rules.md`. It is the only maintained rule source.

Hard minimum: confirm user-visible behavior; test before implementation; keep API contracts and P0 E2E green; diagnose root causes; back up before destructive migration. Load detailed docs and Skill references only when the current Profile, risk, or task routes to them.
